notes: Pure-Python Atheris harness. The Mayhem target is a thin ELF launcher (mayhem/launcher.c) that execs python3 on the harness, because Mayhem requires an ELF target. One target: fuzz-ttp (the original mayhemheroes harness mayhem/fuzz_template.py + mayhem/fuzz_helpers.py, which drives ttp.ttp(data, template).parse() over two fuzzed strings). The behavioral oracle (mayhem/ttp_oracle) is likewise an ELF launcher so the anti-reward-hack sabotage check can neuter it; it parses the seed network-config sample (mayhem/testsuite/seed.data with mayhem/testsuite/seed.template) and asserts the known extracted interface/ip/mask/vrf values.
